description: Rare two-seat Su-7U in overall grey at the 11 BRD entrance gate, reported by Phil Camp (warbirds.in Jan 2015; Bharat Rakshak U-877). Inside the depot approach. Coordinates from warbirds.in map tag.

One of only six MiG-21PF (Type 76) in IAF service, 1965 war veteran with 28 Sqn, later 45 Sqn as C-822 after radar/engine upgrade; displayed inside 11 BRD painted C822 with a hard canopy cover, since the 1980s (warbirds.in with Air Marshal Bhojwani; Bharat Rakshak BC-822). Coordinates from warbirds.in.
